sql:
WITH wins_per_team AS (
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_long_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        l.name as league_name,
        t.team_long_name as team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON (m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    GROUP BY l.name, t.team_long_name
),
combined_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        team_name,
        SUM(win_count) as total_wins
    FROM wins_per_team
    GROUP BY league_name, team_name
),
min_wins_per_league AS (
    SELECT 
        league_name,
        MIN(total_wins) as min_wins
    FROM combined_wins
    GROUP BY league_name
),
qualified_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        c.league_name,
        c.team_name,
        c.total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.league_name ORDER BY c.team_name) as rn
    FROM combined_wins c
    JOIN min_wins_per_league m ON c.league_name = m.league_name AND c.total_wins = m.min_wins
)
SELECT 
    league_name,
    team_name,
    total_wins
FROM qualified_teams
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY league_name
